title: End User License Agreement
summary: We let you play Oreheart for fun. The game stays ours; you get a personal licence to use it.
Coins, cards, packs, decks and other in-game items are licensed to you, not sold. They have no real-money value, and we may change, reset or take back items gained by cheating.
One account each, with a kid-friendly name. Under 13 needs a parent's permission first.
Play fair: no cheating, bots, exploits, taking the game apart, server copies, or buying and selling accounts, cards or coins for real money. Breaking the rules can end your account.
Ranked play, seasons and events are run by us: we may change or end them, settle disputes, and reset ranks each season.
Online play may change, pause or end. We give the game to you as it is, and our responsibility to you is limited, as far as the law allows.
Your privacy is covered by our Privacy Policy, and how to behave by our Code of Conduct. Parents of under-13s have their own consent notice.
This short version is only a guide. The full agreement below is what counts. It is written in plain English on purpose: please read it.

You may not overload, scan, attack, interfere with or try to get around the security of Oreheart's servers, accounts, checks or anti-cheat, or do anything that makes the Game slower or worse for other players.

Each card is a unique instance with its own identity and ownership history, so Oreheart can trace and reverse or remove Items that were gained by cheating, by a bug, by mistake or through any trade or transfer that this Agreement does not allow.

text: Oreheart may run ranked play, seasons, events and other competitions, and may start, pause, change, adjudicate or end any of them at any time. Ranks and standings may be reset at the start of each season.

You may take part only where the law where you live allows you to, and you are responsible for checking that. Rewards are Items under section 3, have no real-money value, and may be withheld or taken back from anyone who breaks this Agreement or the rules of the event.

sections.heading: 5. Patches and updates
text: Oreheart may update, patch or change the Game at any time, including the rules, cards, balance, art, features and Services. Oreheart is a web game that plays in your browser or as an installed web app, so updates arrive when the game reloads; there is nothing to download or install, and you may need the latest version to play online. By keeping an account you agree to receive updates.
The offline practice game runs on your own device and does not need Oreheart's servers. The Services do, and they may be changed, paused or ended as described in section 9.

Oreheart collects only the information described in its Privacy Policy. Oreheart does not keep your birth date (it is only used on the sign-up screen to work out your age group), and does not ask for your real name, photo, phone number or home address, and does not sell your information. For players under 13, the Parent Consent Notice sent to the parent or guardian explains what is collected and how to withdraw permission.

A parent or guardian who gave consent for an under-13 account can withdraw it at any time, which ends the account's online use.

Oreheart may suspend or terminate your account and this Agreement at any time, with or without notice, for any reason, including if Oreheart reasonably believes that: (a) you have broken this Agreement or the Code of Conduct; (b) you have infringed the intellectual property or other rights of Oreheart, anyone affiliated with Oreheart, or anyone else; (c) information you gave, such as your age group or email address, cannot be verified or is false; (d) your conduct in the Game, including your username or anything you send us, is inappropriate, harmful or unsuitable for a game that children play; (e) your account has been unused for a long time (at least 2 years); or (f) the law requires it. Oreheart keeps a record of each of these steps, and you can ask about a decision through the Contact us form.
When this Agreement or your account ends, your right to use the Services stops at once, and all Items on the account are forfeited, with no refund or payment.

Oreheart is free to play. If Oreheart ever accepts donations or payments, they are non-refundable except where the law requires a refund, and they do not buy Items or any advantage. [LAWYER: review before Phase D adds donations or payments.]
